edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
edit.text: Nathaniel Malick finds Kora about to take her own life and talks her into joining his attack on Afterlife.
edit.whoA: Saves Kora from herself and draws her into his plans.
edit.whoB: Daisy's lost sister. Nathaniel recruits her.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
add.text: Nathaniel, who has trained Kora to control her powers and filled her head with talk of meeting her sister Daisy, keeps her close. They share a kiss after she helps the Chronicoms break into the Lighthouse.
add.whoA: Trains Kora's powers and draws her into his plans.
add.whoB: Daisy's lost sister. Nathaniel trains her and keeps her close.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#7
edit.text: Nathaniel works with Sibyl and the Chronicoms against S.H.I.E.L.D.
edit.whoB: A HYDRA ally Sibyl works with.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
add.text: Nathaniel chafes when Sibyl orders him to be patient and leave Quake to her Hunters.
add.whoA: The Chronicom leader Nathaniel works with.
add.whoB: A HYDRA ally Sibyl keeps on a short leash.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
edit.text: Kora is Daisy's half-sister, Jiaying's daughter, alive in the history the Chronicoms change.
edit.whoA: Kora's half-sister.
edit.whoB: Daisy's half-sister.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: Kora, who sided with Nathaniel Malick and fought Daisy at first, turns on him, saves Daisy's life and heads into space at her side.
add.whoA: Kora's half-sister. Enemies at first, they end up fighting side by side.
add.whoB: Daisy's half-sister, an enemy at first, who saves her life.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
edit.text: Jiaying is Kora's mother and raises her in Afterlife, trying to keep her unstable power in check. Kora breaks with her to follow Nathaniel Malick.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
add.text: Nathaniel Malick, whom Kora left Afterlife to follow, kills Jiaying.
add.whoA: Kora's mother, killed by Nathaniel Malick.
add.whoB: Jiaying's daughter, who turns against her for Nathaniel Malick.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
edit.text: While she is still secretly working for Nathaniel Malick, Kora names Daniel as the next person she would kill.
edit.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Kora names as her next target.
edit.whoB: Daisy's half-sister, who names Daniel as her next target.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: A year after Malick's defeat, Kora has joined S.H.I.E.L.D. and flies into deep space with Daniel and Daisy.
add.whoA: Daisy's partner, who explores space with Kora and Daisy.
add.whoB: Daisy's half-sister, who explores space with Daniel and Daisy.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#5
edit.text: In 1973 Daisy takes young Nathaniel hostage to get her team out, and the sight of her power leaves him obsessed with her. Three years later he captures her to take her powers.
edit.whoA: The Inhuman whose power Nathaniel craves.
edit.whoB: Wilfred Malick's son, who captures Daisy to steal her powers.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: Nathaniel, who drained Daisy's blood to steal her powers in 1976, faces her in the final battle, and she kills him.
add.whoA: The Inhuman whose power Nathaniel steals, and who kills him.
add.whoB: Wilfred Malick's son, who tortures Daisy to steal her powers.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#5
edit.text: Daniel helps Daisy take young Nathaniel hostage in 1973. Three years later Nathaniel captures them both.
edit.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nathaniel captures with Daisy.
edit.whoB: Wilfred Malick's son, who captures Daniel and Daisy.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#6
add.text: Nathaniel holds Daniel and Daisy in a barn while he steals Daisy's powers, until Daniel breaks them free.
add.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nathaniel holds captive with Daisy.
add.whoB: Wilfred Malick's son, who holds Daniel and Daisy captive.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
edit.text: Nathaniel lures Jiaying's daughter Kora away from Afterlife and seizes it.
edit.whoA: Kora's mother, whose Afterlife Nathaniel seizes.
edit.whoB: The man who turns Jiaying's daughter against her.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
add.text: When Nathaniel finds Jiaying again at the Lighthouse, he tells her Daisy is her daughter too, then kills her.
add.whoA: Kora's mother, whom Nathaniel kills.
add.whoB: The man who turns Jiaying's daughter against her and kills her.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
edit.text: Freddy Malick, who grows up to be Wilfred Malick, is Gideon's father.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#2
add.text: When Mack tells young Freddy in 1931 that he will be Gideon's father, Freddy insists he is nobody's father.
add.whoA: Freddy's son.
add.whoB: Gideon's father.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
edit.text: In 1931 Deke helps protect young Freddy from the Chronicoms.
edit.whoA: Protects Freddy in 1931.
edit.whoB: Young Malick, whom Deke protects in 1931.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#5
add.text: Deke, who could not bring himself to kill young Freddy in 1931 and was spared by him in the 1950s, shoots him dead in 1976 to stop Project Insight.
add.whoA: Spares Freddy in 1931 and kills him in 1976.
add.whoB: Young Malick, whom Deke spares in 1931 and kills in 1976.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
edit.text: In 1931 Coulson's team saves young Freddy from the Chronicoms.
edit.whoA: Leads the team that saves Freddy in 1931.
edit.whoB: A young man Coulson's team saves in 1931.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#5
add.text: Freddy, who delivered HYDRA its serum ingredient in 1931 despite Coulson's team saving him, is a HYDRA leader inside S.H.I.E.L.D. by 1973. He holds Coulson at gunpoint and lets him go only when Daisy takes his son Nathaniel hostage.
add.whoA: Leads the team that saves Freddy in 1931, then becomes his enemy.
add.whoB: A HYDRA man Coulson's team saves in 1931, who later holds Coulson at gunpoint.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#6
edit.text: Inside the Chronicoms' virtual space, Sibyl tells Coulson his kind will give up, but he blows up their time ship with her body aboard.
edit.whoA: The agent who blows up Sibyl's ship.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: Sibyl, who survived Coulson's blast inside a computer, meets him again on her ship in the final battle and has him at her mercy until May knocks her out.
add.whoA: The agent who destroys Sibyl's body and fights her to the end.
add.whoB: The Chronicom leader Coulson fights through time.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
edit.text: May shows Kora her mother's body and tells her that Nathaniel Malick killed Jiaying, and Kora attacks her rather than believe it.
edit.whoA: The agent who tells Kora the truth about her mother.
edit.whoB: Daisy's sister. May tells her the truth about Jiaying.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
add.text: Once Kora turns on Malick, she and May combine their powers to give the Chronicom Hunters empathy.
add.whoA: The agent who tells Kora the truth about her mother, then fights beside her.
add.whoB: Daisy's sister. May tells her the truth, and they end the Chronicom attack together.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
edit.text: Nathaniel has Garrett kidnap Simmons and steal the Zephyr, planning to use her to find Fitz.
edit.whoA: Fitz's wife, whom Nathaniel takes to find Fitz.
edit.whoB: Malick's son, who kidnaps Jemma to find Fitz.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
add.text: Nathaniel holds Simmons prisoner and climbs into her mind with a fusion machine to hunt for Fitz. He pushes so deep that he erases Fitz from her memory completely.
add.whoA: Fitz's wife, whose mind Nathaniel searches for Fitz.
add.whoB: Malick's son, who tears through Jemma's memories to find Fitz.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#8
edit.text: Sarge hunts Izel across worlds, sure that she killed his family, and means to kill her with his sword.
edit.whoA: Hunts Izel, sure she killed his family.
edit.whoB: The alien Sarge hunts.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
add.text: Izel, who used May's body to shoot Sarge, tells him he is truly Pachakutiq, her old love, lost inside a copy of Coulson's body. She wounded him to wake his true self.
add.whoA: Hunts Izel, but is truly Pachakutiq, her old love.
add.whoB: The alien Sarge hunts, once the one he loved.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#5
edit.text: Holding May prisoner, Sarge mocks her grief over Coulson, but she beats him and brings him in.
edit.whoA: The woman who loved Coulson. Beats Sarge and brings him in.
edit.whoB: A man with Coulson's face. Takes May prisoner.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
add.text: May comes to hope there is good in Sarge, but when he embraces his true self he stabs her and sends her through the portal.
add.whoA: The woman who loved Coulson. Sarge takes her prisoner, then stabs her.
add.whoB: A man with Coulson's face. Takes May prisoner, then stabs her.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#7
edit.text: Mack holds Sarge prisoner and makes an uneasy deal with him to stop the Shrikes.
edit.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, who holds Sarge captive.
edit.whoB: A man with Coulson's face, held captive by Mack.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
add.text: After seizing Zephyr One and taking Mack hostage, Sarge embraces his true self, Pachakutiq, and Mack kills him with his own sword.
add.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director. Holds Sarge captive, becomes his hostage, then kills him.
add.whoB: A man with Coulson's face. Mack finally kills him, using Sarge's own sword.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#8
edit.text: Daisy rides with Sarge in an uneasy truce to hunt the Shrikes.
edit.whoA: The Inhuman who rides with Sarge in an uneasy truce.
edit.whoB: A man with Coulson's face. Daisy rides with him to hunt the Shrikes.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
add.text: After Sarge, who turned his sword on Daisy during their truce, stabs May, Daisy comes for revenge, and her quakes expose his true form so Mack can kill him.
add.whoA: The Inhuman who fights Sarge and helps bring him down.
add.whoB: A man with Coulson's face, who stabs May. Daisy helps bring him down.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#7
edit.text: On the planet Kitson, Izel saves Fitz and Simmons from execution and hires them to take her to Earth for artifacts she says are hers.
edit.whoA: Izel's crew.
edit.whoB: Hires Fitz to take her to Earth.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
add.text: Izel, who has lied to Fitz and Simmons about her past, suspects them of working with Sarge and turns on them.
add.whoA: Izel's crew, then her enemy.
add.whoB: Hires Fitz, then turns on him.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
add.text: Izel takes over Fitz's body at the Lighthouse.
add.whoA: Izel's crew, then her host.
add.whoB: Hires Fitz, then possesses him.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#7
edit.text: On the planet Kitson, Izel saves Fitz and Simmons from execution and hires them to take her to Earth for artifacts she says are hers.
edit.whoA: Izel's crew.
edit.whoB: Hires Simmons to take her to Earth.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
add.text: Izel, who has lied to Simmons and Fitz about her past, suspects them of working with Sarge and turns on them.
add.whoA: Izel's crew, then her enemy.
add.whoB: Hires Simmons, then turns on her.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
edit.text: Izel jumps into May's body, among others, and uses her to shoot Sarge.
edit.whoA: One of Izel's hosts.
edit.whoB: Possesses May.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
add.text: As Izel works to open a gateway for her kind, May kills her before her people can cross through.
add.whoA: One of Izel's hosts, who kills her.
add.whoB: Possesses May, until May kills her.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
edit.text: Izel jumps into Mack's body and takes him with her when she flees the Lighthouse.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#11
add.text: Izel holds Mack hostage and wears his body as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
add.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, Izel's hostage and host.
add.whoB: Takes Mack hostage and possesses him.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
edit.text: Izel tries to take over Daisy's body, but Elena steps in and lets Izel take her instead.
edit.whoB: Tries to possess Daisy.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
add.text: As Izel works to open a gateway for her kind, she ambushes Daisy at the temple and nearly kills her.
add.whoA: An agent Izel tries to possess.
add.whoB: Tries to possess and kill Daisy.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#1
edit.text: Elena and Keller are secretly together, keeping it from Mack, her ex.
edit.whoA: Keller's secret girlfriend.
edit.whoB: Elena's secret boyfriend.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#4
add.text: When a Shrike takes over Keller's body, Elena has to kill him.
add.whoA: Keller's secret girlfriend, who has to kill him.
add.whoB: Elena's secret boyfriend. She kills him when a Shrike takes him.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: Thor holds off Wanda in New Asgard so Kamala's group can escape.
edit.whoA: Holds Wanda off in New Asgard.
edit.whoB: The Queen of the Dead, whom Thor holds off in New Asgard.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Wanda has turned Thor into a zombie for her horde and brings him to Paris.
add.whoA: Holds Wanda off in New Asgard until she turns him into her zombie.
add.whoB: Turns Thor into a zombie.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: Alexei eats the feast Wanda brings to New Asgard and turns.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: In Paris, Wanda sends the zombie Alexei against Kamala.
add.whoA: Turned by Wanda's feast. Now one of her zombies.
add.whoB: Sends the zombie Alexei against Kamala.

edit.text: Okoye hunts Kamala's group for Wanda and storms the North Institute.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#2
add.text: Okoye brings down the New Orleans checkpoint and wakes Namor to chase Kamala's group at sea.
add.whoA: The hero Okoye hunts for Wanda.
add.whoB: The zombie general hunting Kamala.

edit.text: Yelena helps defend the North Institute and, after it falls, joins Kamala's mission to reach space.
edit.whoA: A friend who joins Kamala's mission to reach space.

add.text: On the Raft, Yelena stays behind to launch their escape pod and dies.

edit.whoB: The hero whose mission Alexei joins.

add.text: Kamala talks Alexei out of despair after Yelena dies, but in New Asgard he eats Wanda's tainted food and turns.
add.whoA: A friend Kamala loses to Wanda's feast.
add.whoB: Gives Alexei a reason to go on.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Kamala's group meets Shang-Chi at the Raft's checkpoint, and he joins them after Zemo betrays them.
edit.whoA: A survivor who joins Kamala's group after the Raft.
edit.whoB: The hero whose group Shang-Chi joins.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Shang-Chi tells Kamala she gave them hope and stands with her in the last battle in Paris, where zombies infect him.
add.whoA: A friend who keeps Kamala going.
add.whoB: The hero who gives Shang-Chi's group hope.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Katy joins Kamala's group with Shang-Chi after the Raft falls.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Katy stands with Kamala in the last battle in Paris.
add.whoA: Shang-Chi's best friend, who fights beside Kamala in Paris.
add.whoB: Katy's friend. They fight side by side in Paris.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Zemo lets Kamala's group onto the Raft, then tries to sacrifice them to the zombie Namor. He escapes with them.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#3
add.text: Zemo travels with Kamala's group to New Asgard, where zombies kill him.
add.whoA: Tries to feed Kamala's group to Namor, then dies in New Asgard.
add.whoB: A hero Zemo tries to sacrifice.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: Valkyrie lets Kamala's group into New Asgard and flies them into space after Wanda's betrayal.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Valkyrie fights beside Kamala in Paris and falls in the last stand.
add.whoA: Fights beside Kamala and falls in Paris.
add.whoB: A hero Valkyrie fights beside in Paris.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Katy is Shang-Chi's best friend. They flee San Francisco together and survive five years on the road.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Shang-Chi and Katy fight side by side in the last battle in Paris.
add.whoA: Shang-Chi's best friend.
add.whoB: Katy's best friend.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Jimmy Woo helps Shang-Chi and Katy escape San Francisco and survives with them for five years.

add.text: Zombies kill Jimmy in New Asgard as the group flees.
add.whoA: Survived beside Shang-Chi for five years, until zombies kill him in New Asgard.
add.whoB: Survives five years on the road with Jimmy.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Jimmy returns in Paris as one of Wanda's zombies and infects Shang-Chi.
add.whoA: Killed in New Asgard, then returns as Wanda's zombie and infects Shang-Chi.
add.whoB: Infected by the zombie Jimmy in Paris.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#2
edit.text: Death Dealer flies Shang-Chi's group out of San Francisco and survives with them for years.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#3
add.text: Zombies kill Death Dealer in New Asgard as the group flees.
add.whoA: One of Shang-Chi's father's warriors, killed by zombies in New Asgard.
add.whoB: The son of Death Dealer's master.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: Death Dealer returns in Paris as one of Wanda's zombies and fights Shang-Chi.
add.whoA: One of Shang-Chi's father's warriors. Returns as Wanda's zombie in Paris.
add.whoB: The son of Death Dealer's master, now his foe.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: The sorcerers rescue Peter and Scott from the blast in Wakanda and shelter them at Kamar-Taj for years.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: The sorcerers and Peter fight Wanda's horde together in Paris.
add.whoA: A survivor the sorcerers rescue.
add.whoB: Rescue Peter from the blast in Wakanda.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: The sorcerers rescue Scott and Peter from the blast in Wakanda and shelter them at Kamar-Taj for years.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: The sorcerers and Scott fight Wanda's horde together in Paris.
add.whoA: A survivor the sorcerers rescue.
add.whoB: Rescue Scott from the blast in Wakanda.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: Shang-Chi is in New Asgard when Wanda reveals her feast was zombie flesh, and he tells Valkyrie it is too late to save Thor so the group can flee.
edit.whoA: The Queen of the Dead, who turns New Asgard.
edit.whoB: A survivor who escapes Wanda in New Asgard.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: In Paris Shang-Chi fights Wanda's horde, and her zombies infect him.
add.whoA: Rules the horde that infects Shang-Chi in Paris.
add.whoB: A survivor who fights Wanda's horde.

edit.title: What If...?#8
edit.text: Natasha and Clint wake Zola's mind in a HYDRA base in Siberia and force him to help them destroy Ultron.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Natasha finds the Zola arrow and fires it into Ultron's eye, and Zola takes over his body.
add.whoA: The mind Natasha fires into Ultron's eye.
add.whoB: Fires Zola into Ultron's eye.

edit.title: What If...?#8
edit.text: Fleeing Ultron, the Watcher turns to Strange, whose collapsing universe he once refused to save, and asks for his help.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Together they gather the Guardians of the Multiverse and brief them on Ultron's war.
add.whoA: Gathers the Guardians of the Multiverse with Strange.
add.whoB: Gathers the Guardians of the Multiverse with Uatu.

edit.title: Marvel Zombies#3
edit.text: The sorcerers of Kamar-Taj save them from Wakanda together, and they spend years at Kamar-Taj.
edit.whoB: Scott's companion through the years at Kamar-Taj.

add.title: Marvel Zombies#4
add.text: They fight side by side in Paris, where the zombie Wasp comes for them both.
add.whoA: Peter's companion to the last fight.
add.whoB: Scott's companion to the last fight.

edit.title: What If...?#8
edit.text: Ultron destroys Natasha's world and leaves her one of its last survivors.
edit.whoB: One of the last survivors of Ultron's war.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Natasha ends Ultron by firing Zola into his eye.
add.whoA: Wiped out Natasha's world.
add.whoB: The survivor who destroys Ultron.

edit.title: What If...?#8
edit.text: Natasha and Clint upload Zola into one of Ultron's drones to destroy his hive mind, but it fails because Ultron has left their universe.
edit.whoA: The code sent to destroy Ultron.
edit.whoB: The AI Zola is sent to destroy.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Zola's code destroys Ultron from within, and Zola takes over his body.
add.whoA: The code that destroys Ultron.
add.whoB: Destroyed from within by Zola, who takes his body.

edit.title: What If...?#7
edit.text: Ultron bursts into Thor's world with his army of drones just as Thor's party ends.
edit.whoA: The party prince whose world Ultron invades.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: Thor lures Ultron into the Guardians' trap early and fights him with Strange.
add.whoA: A Guardian who lures Ultron into a trap.
add.whoB: Invades Thor's world.

edit.title: What If...?#14
edit.text: The Watcher counts Peggy as a friend and keeps following her story.
edit.whoB: A friend who follows Peggy's story.

edit.title: What If...?#25
edit.text: The other Watchers put him on trial for his meddling, pointing to how close he has grown to Peggy. She is captured while trying to save him.
edit.whoA: Captured trying to save the Watcher.
edit.whoB: The friend Peggy tries to save.

add.title: What If...?#17
add.text: Peggy pushes back when the Watcher tells her the dying world she has landed in cannot be saved and will not help her.
add.whoA: The hero the Watcher calls a friend.
add.whoB: A friend Peggy argues with.

add.title: What If...?#18
add.text: After Strange's death, the Watcher takes Peggy to see the multiverse.
add.whoA: The hero the Watcher calls a friend.
add.whoB: A friend Peggy argues with.

add.title: What If...?#26
add.text: In the end, Peggy gives her life to carry the Watcher and everyone else to safety.
add.whoA: Dies saving the Watcher.
add.whoB: The friend Peggy dies saving.

edit.title: What If...?#9
edit.text: Gamora destroys the Infinity Gauntlet together with Tony and Eitri, and returns to Tony when the Watcher sends her home.
edit.whoA: Helps Gamora destroy the Infinity Gauntlet.
edit.whoB: Helps Tony destroy the Infinity Gauntlet.

add.title: What If...?#13
add.text: Thanos sends Gamora to kill Tony on Sakaar, but they are locked up together and he urges her to forge her own path. She kills Thanos with his help.
add.whoA: The man Gamora was sent to kill. Now her ally.
add.whoB: Sent to kill Tony. Now on his side.

edit.title: What If...?#25
edit.text: Kahhori serves on Peggy's team of Guardians and goes after her when she goes missing.

add.title: What If...?#26
add.text: After Peggy's sacrifice, Kahhori becomes a watcher of the multiverse.
add.whoA: Kahhori's friend and team leader. Dies saving the team.
add.whoB: Peggy's friend on the team.

edit.title: What If...?#25
edit.text: Kahhori and Peggy's team see shards of the Watcher's realm fall and set out to rescue him from the Fifth Dimension.
edit.whoA: Sets out to rescue the Watcher.
edit.whoB: The Watcher Kahhori sets out to rescue.

add.title: What If...?#26
add.text: Kahhori helps rescue the Watcher from the Fifth Dimension. After Peggy's sacrifice, he invites her to watch over the multiverse with him.
add.whoA: Invited by the Watcher to watch with him.

add.whoB: Exposes Graydon's secret to the Friends of Humanity.

edit.text: After Sabretooth is shot at Beast's trial, Xavier takes him in at the mansion, hoping to reform him.
edit.whoA: Xavier hopes to reform him.

add.text: Xavier puts Sabretooth through therapy, but Sabretooth has been faking and turns on the X-Men.

edit.text: In one timeline, the Sentinel Nimrod travels back to 1959 with Fitzroy, who kills the young Xavier.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#55
add.text: Bishop, Wolverine, and Storm go back to 1959 again, drive off Nimrod, and save the young Xavier, setting history right.
add.whoA: In one timeline, Nimrod helps kill Xavier, until Bishop sets history right.
add.whoB: The mutant leader the Sentinels hunt.

edit.text: When the Phalanx attack the X-Men, Beast teams up with Warlock, Forge, and Sinister to fight them.
edit.whoA: The alien hive Beast fights.
edit.whoB: Teams up with Warlock against the Phalanx.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#68
add.text: Beast helps build the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
add.whoA: Beast helps build the virus that destroys it.
add.whoB: Helps build the virus that destroys the Phalanx.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#67
edit.text: When the Phalanx attack the X-Men, Forge teams up with Warlock, Beast, and Sinister to fight them.
edit.whoA: The alien hive Forge fights.
edit.whoB: Teams up with Warlock against the Phalanx.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#68
add.text: Forge helps destroy the Phalanx.
add.whoA: Forge helps destroy it.
add.whoB: Helps destroy the Phalanx.

edit.text: Cable comes back to Genosha to warn of the Sentinel attack, but he is pulled back to the future before he can.
edit.whoA: Cable comes back to warn of their attack on Genosha.
edit.whoB: Tries to warn of the Sentinels' attack on Genosha.

add.title: X-Men '97#7
add.text: Cable returns and stops Trask, who has been turned into part Sentinel.
add.whoA: Cable comes back in time to stop them.
add.whoB: Fights the Sentinels across time.

add.title: X-Men '97#8
add.text: Cable warns that the Genosha massacre will start a long war on mutants, and he fights Bastion's Prime Sentinels.
add.whoA: Cable comes back to stop their future war.
add.whoB: Fights the Sentinels across time.

edit.text: Banshee leads the X-Men to Cassidy Keep to free Lilandra from Juggernaut and Sean's cousin Tom.

edit.text: Jean and Storm are fellow X-Men, and they scale the Statue of Liberty together to stop Magneto's Brotherhood.

add.title: X2
add.text: Jean and Storm track Nightcrawler to a Boston church and bring him to the team.
add.whoA: Jean's fellow X-Man.
add.whoB: Storm's fellow X-Man.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Alice Wu-Gulliver, a protection witch, into her coven for the Witches' Road.
edit.whoA: A protection witch in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoB: Recruits Alice for the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#5
add.text: After Alice drives Evanora's spirit out of Agatha, Agatha drains her magic and Alice dies. Agatha insists it was an accident.
add.whoA: A protection witch in Agatha's coven. Dies on the Road in an accident Agatha causes.
add.whoB: Recruits Alice for the Witches' Road, and causes Alice's death there.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Agatha Harkness, an old acquaintance, recruits Jennifer Kale into her coven for the Witches' Road, and the two bicker constantly.
edit.whoA: An old acquaintance in Agatha's coven. They bicker constantly.
edit.whoB: An old acquaintance who recruits Jen for the Road. They bicker constantly.

add.title: Agatha All Along#8
add.text: Jen sees the Road through to its end with Agatha.
add.whoA: An old acquaintance in Agatha's coven. They bicker, but Jen sees the Road through.
add.whoB: An old acquaintance who recruits Jen for the Road. They bicker constantly.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Lilia Calderu, a centuries-old divination witch, into her coven for the Witches' Road.
edit.whoA: A divination witch in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoB: The witch who recruits Lilia for the Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#7
add.text: Lilia follows Agatha to the end and gives her life to destroy the Salem Seven.
add.whoA: A divination witch in Agatha's coven, who dies destroying the Salem Seven.
add.whoB: The witch who recruits Lilia for the Road. Lilia follows her to the end.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Alice Wu-Gulliver and Billy, still known only as Teen, walk the Witches' Road together in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoA: A teen who walks the Witches' Road in Alice's coven.
edit.whoB: A protection witch in Billy's coven on the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#6
add.text: Alice is revealed as the police officer who answered the car crash that put Billy into William Kaplan's body.
add.whoA: A boy whose car crash Alice answers. They meet again years later on the Witches' Road.
add.whoB: The police officer who answers Billy's crash. They meet again on the Witches' Road.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Jennifer Kale and Alice Wu-Gulliver walk the Witches' Road together in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoA: A coven sister on the Witches' Road.
edit.whoB: A coven sister on the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#5
add.text: Alice is killed on the Road.
add.whoA: A coven sister on the Witches' Road, until Alice is killed.
add.whoB: A coven sister on the Witches' Road, until Alice is killed.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Lilia Calderu and Alice Wu-Gulliver walk the Witches' Road together in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoA: A coven sister on the Witches' Road.
edit.whoB: A coven sister on the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#5
add.text: Alice is killed on the Road.
add.whoA: A coven sister on the Witches' Road, until Alice is killed.
add.whoB: A coven sister on the Witches' Road, until Alice is killed.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#4
edit.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and walks the Witches' Road with Alice Wu-Gulliver.
edit.whoA: The coven's new Green Witch on the Witches' Road.
edit.whoB: A coven sister on the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#8
add.text: After Alice dies, Rio, who is really Death, guides her spirit to the afterlife.
add.whoA: The coven's Green Witch, really Death, who guides Alice away.
add.whoB: A coven sister Rio guides away as Death.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#2
edit.text: Lilia Calderu, a divination witch, walks the Witches' Road with Billy in Agatha's coven.
edit.whoA: A divination witch in Billy's coven on the Witches' Road.
edit.whoB: A coven friend on the Witches' Road.

add.title: Agatha All Along#6
add.text: Lilia reads William's palm at his bar mitzvah and casts a protective sigil on him. Her reading of his split life line hints at who he really is.
add.whoA: A divination witch whose reading hints at who Billy really is.
add.whoB: A coven friend whose split life line Lilia reads.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#4
edit.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and travels the Witches' Road with Billy, who still goes by Teen. She tells Agatha the boy is not her son.
edit.whoA: The coven's new Green Witch, who says Billy is not Agatha's son.
edit.whoB: A boy on the Road whom Rio says is not Agatha's son.

add.title: Agatha All Along#8
add.text: Rio, who is Death, wants to take Billy because his second life upsets the cosmic balance. When she makes him and Agatha choose who goes with her, Agatha gives her own life instead, and Rio leaves Billy be.
add.whoA: Walks the Road as Death, hoping to take Billy. Takes Agatha instead.
add.whoB: A boy Rio walks the Road to claim, until Agatha goes in his place.

edit.text: Sharon Davis, Agatha's gardening neighbor in Westview, joins Agatha's coven on the Witches' Road alongside Billy.
edit.whoA: Agatha's Westview neighbor, a gardener in Billy's coven.

edit.title: Agatha All Along#4
edit.text: Rio Vidal joins Lilia's coven on the Witches' Road as its new Green Witch.
edit.whoA: The coven's new Green Witch.
edit.whoB: A witch whose coven Rio joins as the Green Witch.

add.title: Agatha All Along#7
add.text: Rio appears to Lilia in her true form as Death, telling her all roads lead to her, and Lilia finally realizes who Rio is during the trial that ends her life.
add.whoA: The coven's Green Witch, really Death, who comes for Lilia in the end.
add.whoB: A witch whose coven Rio joins as the Green Witch. Rio comes to end her life.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#1
edit.text: Aloysius Samberly runs the lab at Daniel Sousa's new S.S.R. office in Los Angeles, and Sousa has him test the strange ice around Jane Scott's body.
edit.whoA: Samberly's boss, who leans on him in the lab.
edit.whoB: The lab chief Sousa leans on.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#5
add.text: Samberly reminds Sousa that he personally hired him, and Sousa trades a slice of pie for the loan of a memory inhibitor.
add.whoA: Samberly's boss, who hired him and leans on him often.
add.whoB: The lab chief Sousa hires and leans on, sometimes for pie.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#7
edit.text: When Whitney Frost shoots Ana during the kidnapping of Jason Wilkes, Jarvis rushes her to the hospital.
edit.whoA: Ana's husband, who rushes her to the hospital when she is shot.
edit.whoB: Jarvis's wife. She is shot while Wilkes is kidnapped.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#8
add.text: While Ana recovers from surgery, Jarvis is consumed by the urge for revenge.
add.whoA: Ana's husband, consumed by revenge after she is hurt.
add.whoB: Jarvis's wife. When she is badly hurt, he craves revenge.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#7
edit.text: Whitney Frost shoots Ana Jarvis while raiding Howard Stark's estate to kidnap Jason Wilkes.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#8
add.text: Edwin shoots Whitney twice to avenge Ana, but the Zero Matter inside her heals the wounds.
add.whoA: The woman who shoots Ana while kidnapping Jason Wilkes.
add.whoB: The woman Whitney shoots while raiding Howard Stark's estate.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#6
edit.text: In Los Angeles, Sousa and Peggy Carter capture Dottie and force her to help them against Whitney Frost.
edit.whoA: The Leviathan assassin Sousa captures and forces to help.
edit.whoB: An agent who captures Dottie and forces her to help.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#7
add.text: Dottie gets away again, killing a police officer as she escapes.
add.whoA: The Leviathan assassin Sousa captures and forces to help, who escapes again.
add.whoB: An agent who captures Dottie and forces her to help, until she escapes.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#6
edit.text: Daniel Sousa unknowingly interrupts Johann Fennhoff, posing as Dr. Ivchenko, while he is hypnotizing Chief Dooley.
edit.whoA: A hypnotist posing as Dr. Ivchenko.
edit.whoB: An agent who unknowingly breaks Fennhoff's hold on Dooley.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#8
add.text: At Stark's warehouse Sousa corners Fennhoff at gunpoint, and Fennhoff tries to talk his way into Sousa's mind.
add.whoA: A hypnotist posing as Dr. Ivchenko. Sousa corners him at gunpoint.
add.whoB: Corners Fennhoff at gunpoint. Fennhoff tries to talk his way into Sousa's mind.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Ray Krzeminski mocks Daniel Sousa's war injury and laughs off Sousa's demand that he apologize to Peggy Carter.
edit.whoA: A colleague who mocks Sousa's war injury.
edit.whoB: A colleague Krzeminski mocks for a war injury.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#3
add.text: Still, the two work the night shift together and follow an anonymous tip that leads them to Stark's stolen inventions.
add.whoA: A colleague who mocks Sousa's war injury, but works the night shift with him.
add.whoB: A colleague Krzeminski mocks for a war injury. Also his night shift partner.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Roger Dooley is chief of the S.S.R.'s New York office, where Daniel Sousa works under him chasing leads on Howard Stark.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#3
add.text: Sousa brings Dooley evidence like Stark's car at the Roxxon refinery, and Dooley puts him on the night shift that turns up Stark's stolen inventions.
add.whoA: Sousa's chief at the SSR's New York office.
add.whoB: An agent under Dooley, chasing leads on Howard Stark.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#1
edit.text: Rose Roberts follows Daniel Sousa from New York to run the front desk of his new S.S.R. office in Los Angeles.
edit.whoA: Sousa's friend, running his office's front desk.
edit.whoB: Rose's boss and friend in Los Angeles.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#2
add.text: Rose is Sousa's confidante, teasing him about not telling Peggy Carter that he is dating Violet.
add.whoA: Sousa's friend and confidante, running his office's front desk.
add.whoB: Rose's boss and friend, whom she teases about not telling Peggy about Violet.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#8
edit.text: Daniel Sousa and Peggy Carter fight their way past Joseph Manfredi's guards and pressure the mob boss into helping them against Whitney Frost, his former lover.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#10
add.text: Manfredi ends up working with them to free Whitney from the Zero Matter.
add.whoA: A mob boss, Whitney's ex, who ends up working with Sousa.
add.whoB: An SSR agent Manfredi ends up working with against the Zero Matter.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#3
edit.text: By 1955, Sousa and Peggy have long since broken up and gone their separate ways.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#3
edit.text: Daniel Sousa, now running the SSR in Los Angeles, learns that Whitney Frost is really the scientist Agnes Cully and investigates her alongside Peggy Carter.
edit.whoA: The woman Sousa investigates with Peggy.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#6
add.text: Working together to stop Whitney brings Daniel and Peggy closer.
add.whoA: The woman Sousa investigates with Peggy, which brings them closer.
add.whoB: The SSR chief in Los Angeles, investigating Whitney with Peggy.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#3
edit.text: Dottie Underwood moves into the Griffith Hotel and befriends Peggy Carter while secretly spying on her for Leviathan.
edit.whoA: Dottie's hotel friend and secret target.
edit.whoB: A hotel friend who secretly spies on Peggy for Leviathan.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#1
edit.text: Dottie resurfaces in New York to rob a bank, and Peggy Carter and Jack Thompson ambush and arrest her.
edit.whoA: Dottie's old foe, who ambushes and arrests her at a bank.
edit.whoB: Peggy's old foe, arrested by Peggy at a bank.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#6
add.text: Dottie knocks Peggy out with a kiss, and Peggy sees that she is the Leviathan operative. From then on they fight more than once.
add.whoA: Dottie's hotel friend and secret target. They fight once Dottie's cover is gone.
add.whoB: A hotel friend who secretly spies on Peggy for Leviathan, then fights her.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#6
add.text: Peggy has to break Dottie out of custody and recruit her for a mission against Whitney Frost.
add.whoA: Dottie's old foe. Has to recruit Dottie against Whitney Frost.
add.whoB: Peggy's old foe, recruited by Peggy against Whitney Frost.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#1
edit.text: Vernon Masters takes Dottie Underwood out of SSR custody in New York and into the FBI's hands.
edit.whoA: Takes Dottie out of SSR custody.
edit.whoB: A prisoner Masters takes out of SSR custody.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#7
add.text: Masters tries to torture Dottie, boasting of the methods he once used on a Nazi prisoner. Dottie tells him she once burned her own flesh with a blowtorch and that he is wasting his time.
add.whoA: Takes Dottie out of SSR custody and tortures her, wasting his time.
add.whoB: A prisoner Masters tortures. Tells him he is wasting his time.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#3
edit.text: Jack Thompson interrogates Edwin Jarvis about Howard Stark's car and threatens to have his wife Ana deported, but Jarvis keeps lying to protect Howard.
edit.whoA: SSR agent who interrogates Jarvis and threatens Ana.
edit.whoB: Howard's butler. Keeps lying to Thompson to protect Howard.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#8
add.text: They end up on the same side when Jarvis volunteers to fly up and stop Howard's hypnotized flight over Manhattan.
add.whoA: SSR agent who interrogates Jarvis and threatens Ana, before they end up allies.
add.whoB: Howard's butler. Keeps lying to Thompson to protect Howard, then helps stop the hypnotized flight.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#7
edit.text: Joseph Manfredi helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate, while his men briefly capture Edwin Jarvis and Peggy Carter.
edit.whoA: Whitney's mob boss, whose men capture Jarvis while he takes Wilkes.
edit.whoB: Peggy's ally, whom Manfredi's men capture.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#8
add.text: After Jarvis shoots Whitney, Manfredi nearly has him shot, until Whitney orders him to keep her enemies alive.
add.whoA: Whitney's mob boss, who nearly has Jarvis shot.
add.whoB: Peggy's ally, whom Manfredi nearly has shot for shooting Whitney.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#5
edit.text: Roger Dooley presses Edwin Jarvis about Howard Stark's fistfight with a general after the Battle of Finow, but the loyal butler gives nothing away.
edit.whoA: SSR chief who presses Jarvis about Howard.
edit.whoB: Howard's loyal butler, who gives Dooley nothing.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#7
add.text: When Dooley is trapped in Leviathan's vest, Jarvis is the one who explains it is about to explode.
add.whoA: SSR chief who presses Jarvis about Howard, then gets trapped in Leviathan's vest.
add.whoB: Howard's loyal butler, who gives Dooley nothing. Explains that Dooley's vest is about to explode.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#3
edit.text: Howard Stark finds that Jason Wilkes is alive but invisible and takes him in at his estate, and the two scientists start working together to cure him.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#10
add.text: Howard and Wilkes build a machine from Whitney Frost's plans and open a rift to draw her out.
add.whoA: Fellow scientist Howard takes in and works to cure.
add.whoB: Fellow scientist who takes Wilkes in and works to cure him.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Roger Dooley runs the SSR's hunt for Howard Stark, who is suspected of selling his weapons to the country's enemies.
edit.whoA: SSR chief who hunts Howard as a suspected traitor.
edit.whoB: Fugitive Dooley hunts.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#4
edit.text: Dooley digs into the Battle of Finow and learns that Howard flew out of Finow the day after the massacre.
edit.whoA: SSR chief who digs into Howard's past at Finow.
edit.whoB: A fugitive whose past at Finow Dooley digs into.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#3
add.text: Dooley blames Howard for the murder of his agent Ray Krzeminski.
add.whoA: SSR chief who blames Howard for the deaths of his own agents.
add.whoB: Fugitive Dooley blames for the SSR agents' deaths.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#7
add.text: Fennhoff kills Dooley before Howard is cleared.
add.whoA: SSR chief who blames Howard for the deaths of SSR agents.
add.whoB: A fugitive Dooley blames for the SSR agents' deaths.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#10
edit.text: Howard Stark returns to Los Angeles to help Peggy Carter stop Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter. As Frost chases the team from the waste facility, Howard and Edwin Jarvis run her down with a car.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#5
edit.text: Jack Thompson brings Johann Fennhoff, posing as the defector Dr. Ivchenko, back to New York after their mission in Russia.
edit.whoA: The fake defector Jack brings home.
edit.whoB: The agent Fennhoff fools into bringing him to New York.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#8
add.text: After turning the SSR against itself, Fennhoff knocks Thompson out during the raid on Stark's warehouse.
add.whoA: The fake defector Jack brings home, who turns the SSR against itself.
add.whoB: The agent Fennhoff fools into bringing him to New York, then knocks out.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Ray Krzeminski and Jack Thompson are fellow SSR agents in New York who work the Howard Stark case together.
edit.whoA: A fellow SSR agent on the Stark case.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#3
add.text: Thompson is shaken when Krzeminski is murdered.
add.whoA: A fellow SSR agent whose murder shakes Jack.
add.whoB: A fellow SSR agent who works the Stark case with Krzeminski.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#7
edit.text: Joseph Manfredi helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate, greeting him with a racist remark.
edit.whoA: Frost's partner, who helps kidnap Wilkes.
edit.whoB: The scientist Manfredi helps kidnap for Frost.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#9
add.text: Manfredi keeps Wilkes under guard while Frost forces him to work on her Zero Matter experiments.
add.whoA: Frost's partner, who kidnaps Wilkes and keeps him under guard.
add.whoB: The scientist Manfredi helps kidnap and keeps under guard for Frost.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#5
edit.text: Johann Fennhoff poses as Dr. Ivchenko, a Soviet defector Peggy Carter rescues, to infiltrate the SSR.
edit.whoA: The agent who rescues Fennhoff, not knowing he is an infiltrator.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#8
add.text: Peggy stops Fennhoff's plan to gas New York.
add.whoA: The agent who rescues Fennhoff, not knowing he is an infiltrator, then stops him.
add.whoB: A fake defector Peggy rescues, who uses her to infiltrate the SSR.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#6
edit.text: Johann Fennhoff, posing as Dr. Ivchenko, begins hypnotizing SSR chief Roger Dooley.
edit.whoA: The SSR chief Fennhoff hypnotizes.
edit.whoB: The fake defector who hypnotizes Dooley.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#7
add.text: Under Fennhoff's control, Dooley ends up in a bomb vest and dies jumping out a window to protect his men.
add.whoA: The SSR chief Fennhoff hypnotizes into wearing a bomb vest.
add.whoB: The fake defector who hypnotizes Dooley, leading to his death.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#5
edit.text: Joseph Manfredi lends Whitney Frost his men for her Zero Matter scheme, and Peggy Carter fights them when she raids the Roxxon warehouse.
edit.whoA: The SSR agent who fights Frost's scheme.
edit.whoB: Frost's mob partner, whose men Peggy fights.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#8
add.text: Manfredi's men take Peggy and Jarvis hostage in the desert.
add.whoA: The SSR agent who fights Frost's scheme, whom Manfredi's men take hostage.
add.whoB: Frost's mob partner, whose men take Peggy and Jarvis hostage.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#2
edit.text: Rufus Hunt, a hired killer sent after Jason Wilkes, attacks Wilkes and Peggy Carter, and she fights him at Isodyne Energy.
edit.whoA: A hired killer who attacks Peggy while hunting Wilkes.
edit.whoB: An agent who fights Hunt while he hunts Wilkes.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#3
add.text: Hunt is then sent to kill Peggy and attacks her at Howard Stark's estate, but she shoots his hand and drives him off.
add.whoA: An assassin sent to kill Peggy.
add.whoB: Hunt's target, who shoots his hand and drives him off.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#4
add.text: Peggy and Jarvis capture Hunt, and she interrogates him with Daniel Sousa.
add.whoA: An assassin sent to kill Peggy, whom she captures and interrogates.
add.whoB: Hunt's target, who captures him with Jarvis and interrogates him.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Sasha Demidov, a silent Leviathan assassin, murders Peggy Carter's roommate Colleen while hunting for a Nitramene bomb, and Peggy fights him off.
edit.whoB: An SSR agent who fights Sasha off after he kills her roommate.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#2
add.text: Peggy fights Sasha again and finally beats him atop the milk truck carrying Leet Brannis.
add.whoA: A Leviathan assassin who kills Peggy's roommate Colleen.
add.whoB: An SSR agent who fights Sasha twice and finally beats him.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#1
edit.text: Roger Dooley is Ray Krzeminski's chief at the SSR and leads him and the other agents on the Spider Raymond case.
edit.whoA: Krzeminski's SSR chief, who leads him on the Spider Raymond case.
edit.whoB: One of Dooley's agents, on the Spider Raymond case.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#3
add.text: When Krzeminski is murdered, Dooley blames Howard Stark and redoubles the hunt for him.
add.whoA: Krzeminski's SSR chief, who blames his murder on Howard Stark.
add.whoB: One of Dooley's agents, whose murder he blames on Howard Stark.

edit.title: Agent Carter S2#3
edit.text: At Whitney Frost's urging, her husband Calvin Chadwick sends Rufus Hunt to kill Peggy Carter.
edit.whoA: Has her husband send Rufus to kill Peggy.
edit.whoB: A hitman sent at Whitney's urging to kill Peggy.

add.title: Agent Carter S2#4
add.text: After Peggy captures him, Hunt tries to blackmail Whitney and Chadwick, and Whitney absorbs him into Zero Matter.
add.whoA: Absorbs Rufus into Zero Matter when he tries to blackmail her.
add.whoB: A hitman Whitney absorbs into Zero Matter.

edit.title: Agent Carter S1#7
edit.text: Posing as the Russian doctor Ivchenko, Johann Fennhoff takes over Chief Dooley's mind and has him lock Jarvis and Peggy in a room.
edit.whoA: A mind controller who has Jarvis locked up.
edit.whoB: Howard Stark's butler, whom Fennhoff has locked up.

add.title: Agent Carter S1#8
add.text: Fennhoff later kidnaps Howard Stark from Jarvis's side, and Jarvis takes to the air to stop the hypnotized Howard.
add.whoA: A mind controller who kidnaps Howard and has Jarvis locked up.
add.whoB: Howard Stark's butler. Takes to the air to stop Fennhoff's plan.

edit.text: Dum Dum Dugan knows Howard Stark from the war against HYDRA. In 1946 he lounges by the pool with Howard while Howard calls the SSR to name Peggy Carter co-head of the new S.H.I.E.L.D.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
edit.text: Mack distrusts Holden Radcliffe's android Aida and warns that she will turn on them. When she does, he cuts her first body's head off with his shotgun axe.
edit.whoA: An agent who distrusts Aida, then cuts her first body's head off.
edit.whoB: Radcliffe's android. Mack distrusts her and beheads her.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#14
add.text: Aida later captures Mack, replaces him with a Life Model Decoy and traps his mind in the Framework.
add.whoA: An agent Aida swaps for a decoy and traps in the Framework.

add.whoB: Vido's father, who raises him and fights to keep him.

edit.whoA: A new Loki Kid Loki finds in the Void.
edit.whoB: A young variant who finds Loki in the Void.

add.whoB: A young variant who rules the Void and helps Loki reach Alioth.

edit.whoB: An older variant who finds Loki in the Void.

edit.whoB: A variant hiding in the bunker President Loki's army storms.

add.whoA: Variant Dox leads the hunters against.
add.whoB: TVA general who leads the hunters against Sylvie.

edit.text: Miss Minutes runs most of the Temporal Loom's work, while Ouroboros only checks in to run diagnostics every few hundred years.
edit.whoA: The Loom's technician, who runs its diagnostics every few hundred years.
edit.whoB: The A.I. that does most of the Loom's work.

add.title: Loki S2#4
add.text: When Miss Minutes sabotages the effort to save the Loom, Ouroboros reboots the system to shut her down.
add.whoA: The Loom's technician, who reboots the system to shut Miss Minutes down.
add.whoB: The Loom's A.I., who sabotages it until Ouroboros shuts her down.

add.title: Loki S2#6
add.text: Ouroboros reprograms Miss Minutes and starts her up again to help the new TVA.
add.whoA: The Loom's technician, who shuts Miss Minutes down, then reprograms her.
add.whoB: The Loom's A.I., who sabotages it until Ouroboros shuts her down and reprograms her.

edit.whoA: Goes rogue with Miss Minutes after He Who Remains dies.
edit.whoB: Renslayer's rogue partner after He Who Remains dies.

add.whoA: Goes rogue with Miss Minutes, hunting Victor Timely.
add.whoB: Renslayer's rogue partner after He Who Remains dies, hunting Victor Timely.

add.whoB: Renslayer's partner in trying to take over the TVA.

edit.text: Miss Minutes helps steer Victor Timely toward taking He Who Remains' place. When she tells him she could be much more to him, he switches her off.
edit.whoA: The man Miss Minutes steers toward He Who Remains' place, who switches her off.
edit.whoB: The TVA's A.I., who wants Victor to take He Who Remains' place.

edit.whoA: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom.
edit.whoB: The god who brings Victor to the TVA to fix the Loom.

add.text: Loki and Sylvie rescue Victor from Renslayer, but when Victor goes out to save the Loom, its radiation tears him apart.
add.whoA: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom, who dies there.
add.whoB: The god who brings Victor to the Loom and rescues him from Renslayer.

add.title: Loki S2#6
add.text: Loki relives the moment of Victor's death again and again trying to save him.
add.whoA: A variant of He Who Remains Loki brings to fix the Loom.
add.whoB: The god who brings Victor to the Loom and keeps trying to save him.

edit.title: Loki S2#3
edit.text: Mobius and Loki track down Victor Timely in 1893 and take him back to the TVA.

add.title: Loki S2#4
add.text: Mobius works with Victor Timely at the TVA to fix the Temporal Loom.
add.whoA: The man Mobius brings to the TVA to fix the Loom.
add.whoB: The agent who brings Victor to the TVA to fix the Loom.

edit.whoA: A variant who attacks the TVA.
edit.whoB: The judge who confronts Sylvie at the TVA.

add.title: Loki S1#4
add.text: Ravonna Renslayer arrests Sylvie as a child for being a variant, but Sylvie escapes the TVA and spends her life on the run. Years later Sylvie captures Ravonna and holds her at sword point, demanding the truth about who created the TVA.
add.whoA: A variant Renslayer arrested as a child, who later holds her at sword point.
add.whoB: The judge who arrested Sylvie as a child, whom she later captures.

edit.text: After X-5 deserts, Loki and Mobius track him down living as the actor Brad Wolfe. Loki scares him into leading them to Sylvie, who enchants him and learns Dox's plan.
edit.whoA: A TVA hunter who deserts to act. Leads Loki to Sylvie once Loki tracks him down.

edit.title: Luke Cage S1#6
edit.text: Bobby Fish meets Claire Temple when she reconnects with Luke over lunch, and he steps away so the two can catch up.
edit.whoA: Luke's old friend, whom Bobby meets over lunch.

add.title: Luke Cage S1#7
add.text: Bobby sits in the back of the barbershop as Claire talks Luke into fighting on.
add.whoA: Luke's old friend, who talks Luke into fighting on while Bobby listens.
add.whoB: Luke's friend, who sits in the back as Claire talks Luke into fighting on.

edit.whoA: Works at Pop's, where Bobby is a regular.
edit.whoB: A regular at Pop's barbershop.

add.title: Luke Cage S1#3
add.text: After Pop's death, Bobby and Luke work together to keep Pop's open, and Bobby stays a loyal friend to Luke.
add.whoA: A loyal friend from Pop's barbershop.
add.whoB: A loyal friend and Pop's regular.

edit.title: Luke Cage S1
edit.text: Bobby Fish is a regular at Pop's barbershop, where he plays chess and argues basketball with Pop.
edit.whoA: Bobby's old friend, whose barbershop is Bobby's second home.
edit.whoB: A regular at Pop's barbershop, at the chessboard.

add.title: Luke Cage S1#3
add.text: Bobby tells Luke he met Pop over chess games in Marcus Garvey Park and kept visiting when Pop got too busy, becoming a fixture at the barbershop. After Pop's death, Bobby helps Luke carry on the way Pop would have wanted.
add.whoA: Bobby's old chess friend, whose shop becomes his second home.
add.whoB: Pop's chess friend, a fixture at the barbershop.

edit.text: Bushmaster beats Luke in their first fight, knocking him out in the street.
edit.whoA: A hero Bushmaster beats in a fight.
edit.whoB: Out to avenge himself on Mariah. Beats Luke in a fight.

add.text: Bushmaster beats Luke again at High Bridge, paralyzing him with a powder and kicking him into the river.
add.whoA: A hero Bushmaster beats twice.
add.whoB: Out to avenge himself on Mariah. Beats Luke twice.

add.title: Luke Cage S2#12
add.text: The two team up for a time to shut down Mariah's heroin refinery, then clash again when he attacks her club.
add.whoA: A hero Bushmaster beats in a fight, then joins against Mariah for a time.
add.whoB: Out to avenge himself on Mariah. Beats Luke in a fight, then allies with him for a time.

edit.title: Luke Cage S2#4
edit.text: Misty starts investigating Bushmaster after the video of him beating Luke, finding Nigel Garrison's body and questioning a man who grew up with him.
edit.whoA: A detective who investigates Bushmaster.

add.title: Luke Cage S2#8
add.text: Misty questions Bushmaster about the attempt on Mariah's life. He greets her as Babylon's finest and boasts that he needs no gun or prosthetic arm to have power.
add.whoA: A detective who questions Bushmaster about the attempt on Mariah's life.
add.whoB: The man Misty investigates during his war on Mariah.

edit.whoA: Mariah's right hand, who comes to the Yardies for her money.
edit.whoB: The Yardie leader who pays Mariah's price with Garrison's head in the bag.

add.whoB: The Yardie leader Shades sees as a threat to Mariah.

add.text: Shades spends the war with Bushmaster trying to keep Mariah alive, and fights him when he storms Harlem's Paradise to kill her.
add.whoA: Mariah's right hand. Fights to keep her alive against Bushmaster.
add.whoB: The Yardie leader set on destroying Mariah. Shades fights to keep her alive against him.

edit.whoB: A waitress Mariah pays to frame Luke.

add.text: When Candace's guilt drives her to Misty Knight, Mariah has her killed.
add.whoA: Pays Candace to frame Luke, then has her killed.
add.whoB: A waitress Mariah pays to frame Luke, then has killed.

edit.text: Candace comes to Misty and agrees to testify against Mariah in return for protection.

edit.whoB: A witness who agrees to testify for Misty.

add.text: Candace is lured out with a text from Misty's stolen phone and murdered before she can testify.
add.whoA: The detective Candace agrees to testify to.
add.whoB: A witness who agrees to testify for Misty, murdered soon after.

edit.whoB: A witness Shades has Mariah pay off.

add.text: When Candace decides to tell Misty the truth, Shades lures her out with Misty's stolen phone and kills her.

edit.whoB: Luke's alibi. Clashes with Misty over him.

add.whoA: A detective Claire clashes with over Luke, then stitches up after a shooting.
add.whoB: Luke's alibi. Clashes with Misty, then stitches her up after she is shot.

edit.whoB: The Stokes crime boss Misty investigates.

add.whoB: The Stokes crime boss Misty arrests for her partner Scarfe's murder.

add.whoA: Cottonmouth's bodyguard, whom he kills for shooting up Pop's Barber Shop.

add.whoA: A buyer of Diamondback's Hammer guns who dies trying to kill him.
add.whoB: The gun supplier Colon dies trying to kill.

add.whoB: A man Pop hires and looks after. Becomes Harlem's hero after Pop's murder.

edit.text: Detective Rafael Scarfe is corrupt, but after Cottonmouth shoots him, Luke protects him so his evidence can reach the police.

edit.text: Tilda Johnson treats Luke's concussion at her herbal shop while he hunts Bushmaster.
edit.whoA: Mariah's daughter, a herbal doctor who treats Luke.
edit.whoB: The man Tilda treats for a concussion.

add.whoA: Mariah's daughter, who treats Luke and whom he saves from a fire.
add.whoB: The man Tilda treats, who saves her from a fire.

add.text: Tilda Johnson treats Luke's concussion at her herbal shop while he hunts Bushmaster, and he pulls her and her mother Mariah Dillard out of a burning building. She later poisons Mariah and turns on Luke when Mariah leaves Harlem's Paradise to him instead of her.
add.whoA: Mariah's daughter, who treats Luke, then turns on him.
add.whoB: The man Tilda treats, then turns on when Mariah leaves him her club.

add.whoB: A councilwoman who dodges Cottonmouth's murder by having the witness killed.

edit.whoB: A Harlem crime boss who calls Rosalie in to work together.

add.text: Mariah Dillard calls Rosalie Carbone and the other crime bosses to a meeting to work together. Once Mariah is arrested, Rosalie turns against her and moves in on Harlem.
add.whoA: A crime boss Mariah calls in to work together, who later turns on her.
add.whoB: A Harlem crime boss who calls Rosalie in to work together. Rosalie later turns on her.

edit.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard cover up her murder of Cottonmouth, and the two become partners in crime.

edit.whoB: Shades's partner in crime. He helps her cover up Cottonmouth's murder.

edit.text: Shades loses faith in Mariah as her war with Bushmaster turns savage. After a fight ends their relationship, he gives himself up to Misty.

edit.whoB: Shades's former lover, whose savage war with Bushmaster makes him leave her.

add.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard cover up her murder of Cottonmouth, and the two become lovers and partners in crime.
add.whoA: Mariah's lover and partner in crime, who helps cover up her murder of Cottonmouth.
add.whoB: Shades's lover and partner in crime. He helps her cover up Cottonmouth's murder.

add.title: Luke Cage S2#12
add.text: Shades betrays Mariah and turns witness against her.
add.whoA: Mariah's former lover, who betrays her and turns witness against her.
add.whoB: Shades's former lover, whose savage war with Bushmaster makes him turn on her.

edit.title: Luke Cage S2#2
edit.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother. After years apart, Mariah comes to Tilda's shop wanting to reunite with her.
edit.whoA: Mariah's daughter, raised apart from her.
edit.whoB: Tilda's estranged mother, who wants to reunite with her.

add.title: Luke Cage S2#8
add.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, but Mama Mabel had Tilda taken from her, and Mamie Johnson raised her.
add.whoA: Mariah's daughter, raised apart from her.
add.whoB: Tilda's mother, who was kept from raising her.

add.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, but Mama Mabel had Tilda taken from her, and Mamie Johnson raised her. Tilda poisons Mariah in prison.
add.whoA: Mariah's daughter, raised apart from her. Poisons Mariah in prison.
add.whoB: Tilda's mother, who was kept from raising her. Tilda poisons her in prison.

edit.text: Police captain Tom Ridenhour, who dated Mariah Dillard in high school, works to bring down her crime family and questions her about the severed heads found at her center.

add.text: Ridenhour offers Mariah a deal, and is murdered while meeting the informant he hired to spy on her.
add.whoA: Mariah's high school boyfriend, now a police captain trying to bring her down.
add.whoB: Ridenhour's high school girlfriend, now the crime boss he is trying to take down.

edit.text: Shades corners Misty and Claire Temple in the basement of Harlem's Paradise, but they overpower him and he is taken into custody.

edit.whoB: A detective who helps overpower Shades.

add.title: Luke Cage S1#13
add.text: Misty spends years trying to bring down Shades, who kills Candace Miller, the witness she needs against Mariah Dillard.

add.whoB: A detective who has hunted Shades for years.

edit.title: Luke Cage S1#2
edit.text: Misty runs into Turk Barrett outside Pop's barbershop and warns him off, surprised to see him so far from Hell's Kitchen.

edit.whoB: A detective who warns Turk off in Harlem.

add.text: Misty finds Turk where Luke left him and arrests him yet again.
add.whoA: A Hell's Kitchen crook Misty warns off, then arrests yet again.
add.whoB: A detective who warns Turk off in Harlem, then arrests him yet again.

add.whoB: Ridenhour's predecessor at the precinct, who returns after his murder.

add.text: Ridley sees Ridenhour's murder solved when Shades confesses that Comanche shot him, and she arrests Mariah Dillard.
add.whoA: Ridley's successor at the precinct, whose murder she sees solved.
add.whoB: Ridenhour's predecessor at the precinct, who returns after his murder.

edit.whoB: The police inspector who questions Shades after the siege.

edit.text: Shades and Darius, known as Comanche, are best friends from their time in prison, and Shades gets him work at Harlem's Paradise on his release.
edit.whoA: Comanche's best friend from prison.
edit.whoB: Shades's best friend from prison.

add.text: Shades and Comanche were once lovers. When Shades learns Comanche is a police informant, he kills him.
add.whoA: Comanche's best friend from prison and former lover, who kills him.
add.whoB: Shades's best friend from prison and former lover. Shades kills him for being an informant.

edit.text: Captain Tom Ridenhour has recruited Comanche, an ex-con close to Shades and Mariah Dillard, as his mole inside the Stokes crime family.
edit.whoA: The police captain who recruits Comanche as a mole.
edit.whoB: Ridenhour's mole inside the Stokes family.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#9

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#13
edit.text: Split in two by his bullet, O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, hunts Connors for revenge.
edit.whoA: The cop who shot O'Reilly, hunted by her violent half.
edit.whoB: Her violent half, Mayhem, hunts Connors for revenge.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#10
add.text: During the Terror outbreak Connors shoots O'Reilly and drops her into the water.
add.whoA: The dirty cop who shoots O'Reilly.
add.whoB: The detective Connors tries to kill.

add.text: After Adina kills Connors, Mayhem hangs his body at the police station with a sign calling him guilty, clearing Tyrone's name.

add.whoB: Her violent half, Mayhem, hunts Connors for revenge.

edit.text: Mina walks O'Reilly through a lab rat that split in two from the same energy, explaining what happened to her.
edit.whoA: The scientist who explains O'Reilly's split.
edit.whoB: The detective whose split Mina studies.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, comes to Mina for a brain scan.
add.whoA: The scientist who explains O'Reilly's split.
add.whoB: The detective whose split Mina studies.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
edit.text: Evita calls on the Loa to open the way so O'Reilly and Tandy can enter the Dark Dimension for Tyrone.
edit.whoA: The girl who opens the way into the Dark Dimension for O'Reilly.
edit.whoB: The detective Evita sends into the Dark Dimension.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: In the final fight, Mayhem guards Evita and the candle that keeps the way open from Andre's creatures.
add.whoA: The girl who opens the way, whom O'Reilly guards.
add.whoB: The detective who guards Evita.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#2
edit.text: Hunting Tandy over a stabbing, O'Reilly tracks down her boyfriend Liam and arrests him.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#5
add.text: O'Reilly presses Liam, still in custody, for leads, and he names a drug dealer from the nightclub where he worked.
add.whoA: The thief O'Reilly arrests.
add.whoB: The detective who arrests Liam.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#1
edit.text: Connors shot Tyrone's brother Billy and covered it up.
edit.whoB: Billy's brother, who saw Connors kill him.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#8
add.text: Tyrone haunts Connors as Billy's ghost and scares a confession out of him.
add.whoA: The cop who killed Tyrone's brother.
add.whoB: Billy's brother. Scares a confession out of Connors.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#10
add.text: Connors frames Tyrone for murder, and Tyrone traps him in the Dark Dimension with his cloak.
add.whoA: The cop who killed Tyrone's brother and framed him.
add.whoB: Billy's brother, who traps Connors in the Dark Dimension.

edit.text: Connors killed Adina's son Billy. Tyrone brings him to her so she can judge him.
edit.whoA: The man who killed Adina's son.
edit.whoB: Billy's mother, who holds Connors's fate.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
add.text: Once she has proof that Tyrone is innocent, Adina kills Connors.
add.whoA: The man who killed Adina's son, and whom she kills.
add.whoB: Billy's mother, who kills Connors.

edit.text: Scarborough defamed Tandy's father to bury the truth about the rig. Tandy tracks him to his house and reads his greed.

edit.whoB: The girl who reads Scarborough's greed.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#8
add.text: Tandy confronts Scarborough with her father's evidence, and in the end she takes his bribe.
add.whoA: The Roxxon executive who buried Tandy's father's name and bribes her.
add.whoB: The girl Scarborough pays off.

add.text: Tandy traps Scarborough's mind in a coma.
add.whoA: The Roxxon executive who buried Tandy's father's name.
add.whoB: The girl who traps Scarborough in his own mind.

edit.text: Andre feeds on despair and traps Tandy in a string of false lives.
edit.whoA: The despair feeder who traps Tandy's mind.
edit.whoB: The girl Andre traps in false lives.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: Tandy breaks free of Andre, and with Tyrone she defeats him for good.
add.whoA: The despair feeder who traps Tandy's mind.
add.whoB: The hero who defeats Andre.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#17
edit.text: Andre convinces Tyrone that Tandy has abandoned him, but Tyrone still goes on to rescue her.
edit.whoA: The despair feeder who tricks Tyrone.
edit.whoB: The young man Andre tricks.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: Tyrone and Tandy defeat Andre for good.
add.whoA: The despair feeder who tricks Tyrone.
add.whoB: The hero who defeats Andre.

edit.text: Andre kills Evita's aunt, Chantelle.
edit.whoA: The niece of the priestess Andre kills.
edit.whoB: The man who kills Evita's aunt.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: When Andre becomes a Loa, Evita keeps the way into the Dark Dimension open so Tyrone and Tandy can face him.
add.whoA: The girl who opens the way to Andre's defeat.
add.whoB: The man who kills Evita's aunt.

edit.text: Melissa is among the people caught in Andre's trance at his club.
edit.whoA: One of the people Andre puts in a trance.
edit.whoB: The man who traps Melissa in his trance.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: Tandy frees Melissa from Andre's trance.
add.whoA: One of the people Andre puts in a trance.
add.whoB: The man who traps Melissa in his trance.

edit.text: Trapped in the Dark Dimension, Mayhem finds Andre's record store of stolen memories and turns it against him.
edit.whoA: The despair feeder O'Reilly spies on.
edit.whoB: With her violent half, Mayhem, turns Andre's records against him.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
add.text: O'Reilly plans to overload Andre with the stolen memories in his record store.
add.whoA: The despair feeder O'Reilly spies on.
add.whoB: With her violent half, Mayhem, turns Andre's records against him.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#20
add.text: In the final fight, O'Reilly holds off Andre's creatures of despair.
add.whoA: The despair feeder O'Reilly spies on and fights.
add.whoB: With her violent half, Mayhem, turns Andre's records against him.

edit.text: Lia helps run the support group Andre heads, calling him when one of its members turns up in hospital.

edit.whoB: The head of Lia's support group.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#16
add.text: Lia also runs Andre's trafficking ring and helps him break Tandy in the ambulance.
add.whoA: Andre's accomplice in his trafficking ring.
add.whoB: Lia's boss in the trafficking ring.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
add.text: When their ring falls apart, Andre drains Lia and abandons her.
add.whoA: Andre's accomplice, whom he drains and abandons.
add.whoB: Lia's boss, who abandons her.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#15
edit.text: Tandy thinks Lia is a victim and confides in her, but Lia tasers her and has her taken in an ambulance.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#16
add.text: Lia helps Andre break Tandy's hope and trap her at the Viking Motel.
add.whoA: The woman Tandy trusts, who betrays her.
add.whoB: The girl Lia tasers and traps.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#10
edit.text: During the Terror outbreak Connors turns a shotgun on Tandy, and she slices it in half.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#14
add.text: In the Dark Dimension Tandy saves Connors from Mayhem and accidentally brings him back with her.
add.whoA: The dirty cop who tries to shoot Tandy.
add.whoB: The girl who cuts Connors's gun in half.

edit.text: Maximus is Black Bolt's brother, who came out of Terrigenesis without powers and craves the throne. He seizes Attilan in a coup, and Black Bolt finally seals him in a bunker as the city is abandoned.

edit.title: Inhumans
edit.text: Gorgon is Black Bolt's cousin and the head of his Royal Guard. Black Bolt sends him to Earth to find Triton.

add.title: Inhumans#6
add.text: Gorgon goes to free Auran's hostages at Declan's lab, and dies stopping Mordis.
add.whoA: Black Bolt's cousin, who dies stopping Mordis.
add.whoB: Gorgon's cousin and king.

edit.title: Inhumans
edit.text: Triton is Black Bolt's cousin, sent by him to Earth to find new Inhumans. He is shot on Oahu and feared dead.
edit.whoA: Black Bolt's cousin, sent on his secret mission to Earth.

add.title: Inhumans#7
add.text: Triton returns alive and captures Maximus for Black Bolt.
add.whoA: Black Bolt's cousin, who captures Maximus for him.
add.whoB: Triton's cousin and king.

edit.title: Inhumans
edit.text: Maximus's guards, posing as a military strike team, shoot Triton on Oahu, and he falls into the sea, feared dead.
edit.whoA: Triton's cousin, whose men shoot him.
edit.whoB: Maximus's cousin, shot by his men.

add.title: Inhumans#7
add.text: Triton kills Maximus's bodyguards, captures his cousin and delivers him to Black Bolt.
add.whoA: Triton's cousin, whom he captures.
add.whoB: Maximus's cousin, who captures him.

edit.title: Inhumans
edit.text: During his coup, Maximus has his sister in law Crystal captured and locked up.
edit.whoA: Crystal's brother in law, who holds her prisoner.
edit.whoB: Maximus's sister in law, whom he holds prisoner.

add.title: Inhumans#2
add.text: Maximus presses Crystal to back his rule, offering her the choice of staying locked up or joining him, and threatens Lockjaw when she refuses.
add.whoA: Crystal's brother in law, who holds her prisoner.
add.whoB: Maximus's sister in law, whom he holds prisoner.

add.title: Inhumans#3
add.text: Crystal pretends to agree, then disowns Maximus before the Genetic Council and escapes to Earth with Lockjaw.
add.whoA: Crystal's brother in law, whose rule she defies.
add.whoB: Maximus's sister in law, who defies him.

edit.title: Inhumans#1
edit.text: In Maximus's coup, Auran holds Medusa while Maximus shaves her head.
edit.whoA: The queen Auran holds down for Maximus.
edit.whoB: The guard who holds Medusa as her head is shaved.

add.title: Inhumans#2
add.text: Auran tracks Medusa on Oahu and fights her, and Medusa stabs her. Auran heals and keeps hunting the royals.
add.whoA: The queen who stabs Auran on Oahu.
add.whoB: The guard who hunts Medusa.

edit.title: Inhumans#7
edit.text: Karnak persuades Auran to give him her DNA to revive Gorgon.
edit.whoA: The royal who persuades Auran to help.
edit.whoB: The guard who gives her DNA to save Gorgon.

add.title: Inhumans#8
add.text: Auran leaves Maximus and joins the royals' evacuation of Attilan.
add.whoA: The royal whose family Auran follows to Earth.
add.whoB: The guard who leaves Maximus to join the evacuation.

edit.title: Inhumans#4
edit.text: As head of the Royal Guard under Maximus, Auran hunts Black Bolt on Earth and corners him at Declan's facility.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Auran tries to lure Black Bolt back using Declan and Sammy as hostages.
add.whoA: The king Auran tries to lure into a trap.
add.whoB: Maximus's guard, who uses hostages to lure Black Bolt.

edit.title: Inhumans#4
edit.text: Auran's party corners Sammy and Black Bolt at Declan's facility.
edit.whoA: The inmate Auran's party corners with Black Bolt.
edit.whoB: The guard who corners Sammy and Black Bolt.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Auran's party captures Sammy, and Auran has him brought to her to use as bait to lure Black Bolt back.
add.whoA: The prisoner Auran uses as bait.
add.whoB: The guard who uses Sammy as bait.

edit.title: Inhumans#4
edit.text: Black Bolt takes the unconscious Locus with him to help find his family.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Locus criticizes Black Bolt's rule as she tracks his family. Dying, she asks him to rethink it.
add.whoA: The king whose rule Locus criticizes.
add.whoB: Maximus's guard, who begs Black Bolt to change.

edit.title: Inhumans#4
edit.text: Medusa takes the unconscious Locus captive.
edit.whoB: The guard Medusa takes captive.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Before she dies, Locus tells Medusa that Crystal is on Oahu.
add.whoA: The queen who holds Locus captive.
add.whoB: The captive who tells Medusa where Crystal is.

edit.text: Louise drives off from Declan's facility with the captured Locus in her trunk.
edit.whoA: The human who drives off with Locus in her trunk.
edit.whoB: The guard Louise carries off as a captive.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Locus is held captive by Louise and the royals, and in the end turns to help them.
add.whoA: The human who helps hold Locus captive.
add.whoB: The captive who turns to help Louise and the royals.

edit.text: Declan arranges Black Bolt's escape from jail and flies him off to his lab.
edit.whoA: The jailed king Declan breaks out.
edit.whoB: The scientist who gets Black Bolt out of jail.

add.title: Inhumans#4
add.text: Declan studies Black Bolt's DNA for Maximus, until Black Bolt sees through him and escapes.
add.whoA: The king whose DNA Declan harvests.
add.whoB: The scientist who experiments on Black Bolt.

edit.text: Declan's research helps bring Gorgon back, but the revived Gorgon wakes in a rage and comes at Declan.
edit.whoA: The revived royal who comes at Declan in a rage.
edit.whoB: The scientist whose research helps revive Gorgon.

add.title: Inhumans#8
add.text: The raging Gorgon kills Declan.
add.whoA: The revived royal who kills Declan.
add.whoB: The scientist Gorgon kills in a rage.

edit.title: Inhumans#3
edit.text: Sammy is Black Bolt's fellow inmate and breaks him out of prison.

add.title: Inhumans#6
add.text: Black Bolt sends his cousins to rescue Sammy from Auran.
add.whoA: The inmate Black Bolt has rescued.
add.whoB: The king who sends help for Sammy.

edit.whoA: The human Medusa forces to help her at gunpoint.
edit.whoB: The stranger who forces Louise to help her at gunpoint.

add.title: Inhumans#4
add.text: Louise learns where Medusa comes from and chooses to help her find Black Bolt, and Medusa admits she likes her.
add.whoA: Medusa's friend on Earth.
add.whoB: Louise's friend, the queen of Attilan.

add.title: Inhumans#8
add.text: Medusa calls Louise her most trusted friend and leaves the Terrigen crystals with her.
add.whoA: Medusa's most trusted friend, who keeps the Terrigen crystals.
add.whoB: Louise's close friend, the queen of Attilan.

edit.title: Inhumans#4
edit.text: Louise helps rescue Black Bolt from Auran's party at Declan's facility.
edit.whoA: The human who helps rescue Black Bolt.
edit.whoB: The king Louise helps rescue.

add.title: Inhumans#8
add.text: Louise helps Black Bolt's people find a home on Earth.
add.whoA: The human who helps Black Bolt's people.
add.whoB: The king Louise helps.
