edit.whoA: The man whose quad bike hits Crystal's dog.
edit.whoB: The princess whose dog Dave hits.

add.title: Inhumans#4
add.text: Dave takes Crystal and the wounded Lockjaw home and gets his ex Audrey to treat him, and the two begin to warm to each other.
add.whoA: The man who helps Crystal's wounded dog.
add.whoB: The princess Dave takes in.

add.title: Inhumans#6
add.text: Crystal and Dave have grown close, and they kiss before her family finds her.
add.whoA: The farmer who helps Crystal and wins her heart.
add.whoB: The princess Dave helps and grows close to.

edit.title: Inhumans#3
edit.text: Dave hits the exhausted Lockjaw with his quad bike.
edit.whoA: The giant dog Dave hits.
edit.whoB: The man who runs Lockjaw over.

add.title: Inhumans#4
add.text: Dave shelters Lockjaw in his barn and gets his ex Audrey to treat him.
add.whoA: The giant dog Dave helps heal.
add.whoB: The man who cares for Lockjaw.

edit.title: Inhumans#3
edit.text: Jen is one of the growers holding Karnak captive, and the only one kind to him. She tends his wounds.
edit.whoA: The grower who holds Karnak captive, then tends his wounds.
edit.whoB: Jen's wounded captive.

add.title: Inhumans#4
add.text: Karnak and Jen bond and fall for each other, and they kiss.
add.whoA: The grower Karnak falls for.
add.whoB: Jen's captive, whom she falls for.

add.title: Inhumans#5
add.text: Karnak and Jen sleep together. When they are shot at he pulls the bullet from her wound, but once Gorgon frees them, Jen goes her own way.
add.whoA: The grower who becomes Karnak's lover.
add.whoB: Jen's captive, who becomes her lover.

edit.title: Inhumans
edit.text: Lockjaw teleports into the Quiet Room and carries Black Bolt to Earth before Maximus's guards can seize him.

add.title: Inhumans#7
add.text: Black Bolt has Lockjaw howl on the beach to call Triton home.
add.whoA: The royal dog whose howl calls Triton home.
add.whoB: The king who has Lockjaw call Triton home.

edit.whoB: Geoffrey's wife. Takes the blame to free him.

add.title: Runaways S3#3
add.text: Catherine is killed in prison, which devastates Geoffrey.
add.whoA: Catherine's husband, devastated by her death.
add.whoB: Geoffrey's wife, killed in prison.

edit.whoA: Geoffrey's old friend, who took the fall for him.
edit.whoB: Geoffrey's wife, who had Darius take the fall.

add.text: Catherine frames Darius for Destiny Gonzalez's murder and shoots him dead to clear the Runaways.
add.whoA: Geoffrey's old associate, whom Catherine frames and kills.
add.whoB: Geoffrey's wife. Frames Darius for murder and shoots him.

edit.text: Catherine suspects Molly saw one of PRIDE's sacrifices and questions her.
edit.whoA: A girl Catherine suspects saw PRIDE kill.
edit.whoB: Alex's mother. Questions Molly.

add.text: Catherine plots with the Yorkes to send Molly away, out of PRIDE's reach.
add.whoA: A girl Catherine plots to send away.
add.whoB: Alex's mother. Plots to send Molly away.

edit.text: Catherine and the Yorkes serve in PRIDE together.
edit.whoA: Fellow PRIDE members.
edit.whoB: A fellow PRIDE member.

add.text: Once Catherine learns Molly has seen a sacrifice, she and the Yorkes agree to send Molly away.
add.whoA: Fellow PRIDE members, with whom Catherine plots to send Molly away.

add.text: Jonah finds out that Catherine and the Yorkes tried to send Molly away from him.
add.whoA: Fellow PRIDE members, caught with Catherine hiding Molly from Jonah.

edit.text: Catherine takes part in the sacrifices that keep Jonah alive.
edit.whoA: The man PRIDE kills for.
edit.whoB: A PRIDE member who serves Jonah.

add.text: When Jonah threatens her and Geoffrey over Karolina, Catherine vows to have nothing more to do with him.
add.whoA: The man PRIDE kills for. Catherine comes to defy him.
add.whoB: A PRIDE member who serves Jonah, then turns against him.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#16
add.text: Catherine hopes aloud that the ailing Jonah dies before his ship launches.
add.whoA: The man PRIDE kills for, whom Catherine hopes will die.
add.whoB: A PRIDE member who hopes Jonah dies.

edit.text: Frank raises Karolina as his daughter.
edit.whoA: Frank's daughter.
edit.whoB: The father who raised Karolina.

add.text: Karolina tells Frank the truth about PRIDE's rituals.
add.whoA: Frank's daughter, who tells him about PRIDE.
add.whoB: The father Karolina trusts with the truth about PRIDE.

add.text: Frank passes everything Karolina told him on to Jonah.
add.whoA: Frank's daughter, whose secrets he gives to Jonah.
add.whoB: The father who passes Karolina's secrets to Jonah.

add.text: Jonah is Karolina's real father, but Frank insists that he is still her father because he raised her.
add.whoA: Frank's daughter. He raised her, though Jonah is her real father.
add.whoB: The father who raised Karolina, though Jonah is her real one.

edit.text: The two unite against Jonah for a time, but when Leslie moves to shut the church down, Frank wins her followers over and has her taken for reindoctrination.
edit.whoA: Frank's wife, whom he turns on to keep the church.
edit.whoB: Leslie's husband, who turns her church against her.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#21
add.text: Frank has Leslie held in the Crater.
add.whoA: Frank's wife, whom he imprisons to keep the church.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband. Imprisons her in the Crater to keep the church.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#22
add.text: Leslie escapes the Crater with Karolina's help.
add.whoA: Frank's wife, who escapes the Crater he held her in.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband, who held her in the Crater.

edit.whoB: Victor's son.

edit.text: Freed from Jonah's family, Victor escapes the Dark Dimension with Chase's help.
edit.whoA: Chase's father, back at his side.
edit.whoB: Victor's son.

add.text: Victor is Chase's father, a brilliant and abusive inventor. When Victor attacks Chase over the Fistigons, Janet shoots him.

add.whoB: Victor's son. Victor attacks him over the Fistigons.

add.text: Victor learns what has become of Janet.
add.whoA: Chase's father, who learns Janet's fate.

add.text: Victor fights beside Chase against Morgan.

add.whoB: Janet's son.

edit.text: Janet is married to Victor.
edit.whoA: Janet's husband.
edit.whoB: Victor's wife.

edit.text: After Janet's body vanishes, Victor finds her mind living on in the algorithm.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#7
add.text: Victor has grown abusive, and Janet shoots him when he attacks Chase.
add.whoA: Janet's husband, whom she shoots.
add.whoB: Victor's wife, who shoots him.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#16
add.text: Janet frees Victor from Jonah's algorithm.
add.whoA: Janet's husband, whom she shoots, then saves.
add.whoB: Victor's wife.

add.text: Together Janet and Victor cut off Morgan le Fay's phones.
add.whoA: Janet's husband, who fights Morgan with her.
add.whoB: Victor's wife, alive inside the algorithm.

edit.text: Leslie is Karolina's mother and the leader of the Church of Gibborim. Karolina learns she is part of PRIDE.

edit.text: Leslie gives birth to Karolina's sister, Elle, with the Runaways' help.
edit.whoB: Leslie's daughter.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#22
add.text: Once Leslie turns on Jonah, Karolina rescues her from the church's desert camp.
add.whoA: Karolina's mother, leader of the Church of Gibborim.
add.whoB: Leslie's daughter.

add.text: Six months later, Leslie welcomes Karolina home after the Dark Dimension.
add.whoA: Karolina's mother, who welcomes her home.
add.whoB: Leslie's daughter, home at last.

edit.text: Jonah captures Karolina and reveals that he is her real father. Her friends free her.
edit.whoA: Karolina's real father, who captures her.

edit.text: Jonah traps Karolina in the healing algorithm and tries to bend her to his plan.
